We need DBE for C10H13NO4. DBE formula: DBE = C - H/2 + N/2 +1 (ignoring halogens). For formula with O ignored. So C=10, H=13, N=1. DBE = 10 - 13/2 + 1/2 +1 = 10 -6.5 +0.5 +1 = 5.0. So integer 5.

We could retrieve formula via tool but we already know. Might still call retrieve_dbe_formula for completeness. Use tool.
